comment: Overall impression: It is an important milestone in architectural approaches to information systems development. This was a missing canonical piece that was necessary for WHO to propagate the enterprise continuum framework of TOGAF. Without this, countries will have to create and define their own architectures out of necessity. WHO and ITU would've missed out on a great opportunity to share artifacts to the regions and the countries.
